2. Measures: basic IT training / outreach, keep some offline service counters, make apps accessible and simple, provide free Wi-Fi and devices in community centres.
ex.az: 电脑能力低的人（如长者）最受影响；措施：基础 IT 培训、保留实体柜台、简单易用的 app、社区免费 Wi-Fi 与设备。

cards.tz: 电子废物
cards.en:
Intuition: every "upgrade" leaves an old gadget behind. Where does it go?

Eager to follow trends, we often replace products even when they still work. Disposed products become electronic waste (e-waste). In 2019, 53.6 million tonnes were produced worldwide.

Why harmful: e-waste contains toxic substances: lead (鉛), mercury (水銀), brominated flame retardants (溴化阻燃劑). If they leak into soil or rivers, the ecosystem and residents' health are seriously affected.

Hong Kong: WEEE recycling scheme (四電一腦): free recycling; after buying an air-conditioner, refrigerator, washing machine, TV, computer, printer, scanner or monitor, citizens can request free door-to-door removal of the old one by statutory (licensed) recyclers.

Exam wording: "toxic substances such as lead and mercury leak into soil and rivers, harming the ecosystem and health".
cards.zh:
直觉：每次"升级"都会留下一部旧机，它去了哪里？

为追潮流，仍能用的产品也被换掉，变成电子废物。2019 年全球 5360 万公吨。

害处：含铅、水银、溴化阻燃剂等有毒物质，渗入泥土河流会严重影响生态和居民健康。

香港 WEEE 计划（四电一脑）：免费回收；买冷气机、雪柜、洗衣机、电视、电脑、打印机、扫描器、显示器后可申请免费上门除旧。

ex.q: Name three toxic substances in e-waste and one effect.
ex.a:
1. Lead, mercury, brominated flame retardants.
2. Leaking into soil/rivers harms the ecosystem and residents' health.
ex.az: 铅、水银、溴化阻燃剂；损害生态和健康。

ex.q: Ms Wong buys a new refrigerator. How can she dispose of the old one properly?
ex.a:
1. Under the WEEE (四電一腦) scheme, request free removal when buying.
2. A licensed recycler collects the old fridge door to door.
3. It is treated safely and materials are recovered.
ex.az: 四电一脑计划免费上门除旧。

ex.q: Give two ways a student can reduce e-waste.
ex.a:
1. Use devices longer; don't replace working phones just for trends.
2. Repair or donate/resell old devices; recycle at collection points.
ex.az: 用耐一点；维修、捐赠或回收。

ex.q: "Throwing an old phone in the normal rubbish bin is fine; it's small." What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. The battery and circuit board contain toxic substances.
2. In landfill they can leak into soil and water.
3. Use a recycling point instead.
ex.az: 手机含有毒物质，会渗漏；应回收。

frames.en: Buy a new TV / fridge / computer.
Request free removal of the old one.
A licensed recycler collects it door to door.
Toxic parts (lead, mercury) handled safely at the treatment plant.
Metals and plastics are recovered and reused: no leaking into soil.

cards.tz: 能源危机
cards.en:
Intuition: Earth's fuel tank is finite. More gadgets → more electricity → we drain the tank faster.

Popular electronic products increase energy consumption. Because of limited energy reserves on Earth, this intensifies the energy shortage and brings greater harm to nature during resource extraction (能源開採).

EnergyOilNatural gasUranium (nuclear)Coal
Years before depletion40-5060-7060-70200-300

(World Energy Council, 2013.) Oil runs out first.

Simple saving actions: turn off computers after work; battery optimisation; dark mode on OLED; lower brightness; close unused apps/tabs.
cards.zh:
直觉：地球的油箱有限。电子产品越多→用电越多→油箱越快见底。

电子产品普及增加能源消耗。由于地球能源储备有限，这会加剧能源短缺，开采时对大自然伤害更大。

能源石油天然气铀煤
耗尽年数40-5060-7060-70200-300

石油最先耗尽。省电：下班关电脑、电池优化、OLED 深色模式、调低亮度、关闭不用的 app。

ex.q: Using the 2013 data, in about which year range might oil run out?
Explain two problems caused by high energy consumption.
ex.a:
1. Intensifies the energy shortage: limited reserves used up faster.
2. Harm to nature during extraction: mining and drilling damage land and water.
ex.az: 加剧能源短缺；开采伤害大自然。

ex.q: Give three ICT habits to save energy at school.
ex.a:
1. Turn off computers and projectors after lessons.
2. Lower screen brightness.
3. Close unused programs/tabs.
ex.az: 关电脑投影机；调低亮度；关闭不用程序。

ex.q: "Coal will last 200-300 years, so energy is not a problem." Comment.
ex.a:
1. Oil and gas run out much sooner (40-70 years).
2. Burning coal also causes pollution and harm from extraction.
3. Reserves are limited; saving is still needed.
ex.az: 石油天然气更快耗尽；煤也污染；仍要节约。

cards.t: Energy labels (Mandatory Energy Efficiency Labelling Scheme)
cards.tz: 能源标签（强制性能源效益标签计划）
cards.en:
Intuition: like a school grade for appliances: Grade 1 is best.

Since 2009, the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department (EMSD) runs the Mandatory Energy Efficiency Labelling Scheme (強制性能源效益標籤計劃). Prescribed products sold in HK must carry an energy label.

Purpose: help citizens distinguish products' energy efficiency and raise awareness of saving energy.

Five grades: Grade 1 (green) consumes the least energy, up to Grade 5 (most). A Grade 1 air-conditioner can save 43% of electricity vs Grade 5. The label also shows annual energy consumption (kWh).

Products: air-conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, dehumidifiers, televisions, etc.
cards.zh:
直觉：像电器的成绩：1 级最好。

自 2009 年起，机电工程署 (EMSD) 实施强制性能源效益标签计划。

目的：帮市民分辨能源效益、提高节能意识。

五级：1 级（绿色）最省电，5 级最耗电。1 级冷气机比 5 级省 43% 电。标签亦显示每年耗电量 (kWh)。

ex.q: A Grade 5 air-conditioner uses 1,000 kWh a year. Estimate the Grade 1 model's use if it saves 43%.
ex.a:
1. Saving = 43% × 1,000 = 430 kWh.
2. Grade 1 use = 1,000 − 430 = 570 kWh per year.

ex.q: Continue: electricity costs $1.5 per kWh. How much money does the Grade 1 model save per year?
State two purposes of the energy label scheme.
ex.a:
1. Help citizens distinguish products' energy efficiency.
2. Raise awareness of saving energy.
ex.az: 分辨能源效益；提高节能意识。

ex.q: "A Grade 5 label means the best, like 5 stars." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. In HK's scheme Grade 1 is the most efficient (least energy).
2. Grade 5 uses the most.
ex.az: 1 级最省电，5 级最耗电。

cards.t: Positive impact: smart use of electricity
cards.tz: 正面影响：智能用电
cards.en:
Intuition: machines that can "see" real conditions waste less than machines on a fixed timer.

With the Internet of Things and smart cities, machines combine sensors and artificial intelligence to get real-time information and adjust operation modes to reduce waste → sustainable development.

  • Real-time Adaptive Traffic Signal System (實時交通燈號調節系統): adjusts green time by real-time traffic and pedestrian flow → less waiting, less congestion.
  • Smart meters: monitor electricity use.
  • Smart parking meters: e-payment + real-time vacant spaces → less car exhaust from circling.
  • Free-Flow Tolling: no stopping at toll booths → saves manpower, smoother traffic, less carbon emission.
cards.zh:
直觉：能"看见"实际情况的机器，比固定定时的机器少浪费。

透过物联网和智慧城市，机器结合感应器和人工智能取得实时资讯并调整运作模式减少浪费，达致可持续发展。

  • 实时交通灯号调节系统：按实时车流人流调整绿灯时间，减少等候和挤塞。
  • 智能电表：监察用电。
  • 智能咪表：电子付款+实时空位，减少兜圈废气。
  • 不停车缴费：免停收费亭，省人手、交通畅顺、减碳。

ex.q: How does a real-time adaptive traffic signal reduce energy waste?
ex.a:
1. Sensors count cars and pedestrians.
2. The system gives longer green to the busy road, shorter to the empty one.
3. Fewer cars idling → less fuel burnt and less exhaust.
ex.az: 感应车流→调整绿灯→少怠速→省燃料减废气。

ex.q: Explain how smart parking meters help the environment.
ex.a:
1. Drivers see real-time vacant spaces on an app.
2. They drive straight there instead of circling.
3. Less car exhaust.
ex.az: 实时空位→不用兜圈→少废气。

ex.q: Give two benefits of Free-Flow Tolling.
ex.a:
1. No stopping at toll booths → smoother traffic and less carbon emission.
2. Saves manpower.
ex.az: 交通畅顺减碳；省人手。

ex.q: "A traffic light on a fixed 60-second timer is just as efficient." Why is this wrong?
ex.a:
1. A fixed timer gives green even when no cars wait, and red when a queue builds.
2. Adaptive signals use real-time data to cut waiting and idling.
ex.az: 固定时间不理实际车流；实时调节更有效。

frames.en: Road sensors/cameras detect 12 cars on Road A, 1 car on Road B.
Data is sent to the control centre in real time (IoT).
The system gives Road A a longer green.
frames.zh: 系统决定 A 路绿灯较长。

frames.en: Fewer cars idle → less congestion, fuel and CO₂.
frames.zh: 少怠速→少挤塞、少燃料和二氧化碳。

cards.t: Positive impact: pollution monitoring, carbon footprint, going paperless
cards.tz: 正面影响：污染监测、减碳、无纸化
cards.en:
Intuition: IT can be the problem (e-waste, energy) but also part of the solution.

  • Pollution monitoring: IT tracks environmental changes so timely action can be taken. HK uses remote sensing devices for air pollution and unmanned vessels (無人船隻) for water quality in reservoirs (e.g. Plover Cove).
  • Reduction of carbon footprint: work from home and video conferences save travel time and cut energy use and CO₂.
  • Going paperless: e-books, e-statements, e-learning. Easy to manage, store and search, and protects the ecosystem. (2021: printer paper production in major countries fell 20-30%.)

Protecting the environment: the 3Rs: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle; stakeholders: government, businesses, citizens.
cards.zh:
直觉：IT 可以是问题（电子废物、耗能），也可以是解决方法。

  • 污染监测：香港用遥感装置监测空气污染，无人船监测水塘水质（如船湾）。
  • 减少碳足迹：在家工作、视像会议，省交通时间，减少能源和二氧化碳。
  • 无纸化：电子书、电子月结单、电子学习；方便管理、储存、搜寻，保护生态。

3R：Reduce、Reuse、Recycle；持份者：政府、企业、市民。

ex.q: A company holds a weekly meeting with 20 staff who each travel 10 km by car. If they switch to video conference, how many km of driving are saved per week (round trip)?
ex.a:
1. One trip each way: 20 × 10 = 200 km.
2. Round trip: 200 × 2 = 400 km saved per week.
3. Less fuel → less CO₂.

ex.q: How do unmanned vessels help protect reservoirs?
ex.a:
1. They travel the reservoir and measure water quality automatically.
2. Problems are found early → timely action.
ex.az: 自动量水质，及早处理。

ex.q: Give two benefits of switching to e-statements.
ex.a:
1. Saves paper → protects trees/ecosystem.
2. Easy to store and search old statements.
ex.az: 省纸；方便储存搜寻。

ex.q: "Going paperless has zero environmental cost." Comment.
ex.a:
1. Digital storage uses servers and electricity, and devices become e-waste.
2. It reduces paper use but is not zero impact; still apply the 3Rs.
ex.az: 无纸化仍需服务器用电和装置；不是零影响。

cards.tz: 流动装置省电
cards.en:
Intuition: the screen and radios (Wi-Fi, GPS) are the hungriest parts of a phone.

  • Turn on battery optimisation / power-saving mode.
  • Lower brightness or auto-brightness; shorter automatic screen lock time.
  • Dark mode on OLED screens: each OLED pixel makes its own light; black pixels do not emit light and consume no power.
  • Close unused apps and browser tabs; turn off Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/GPS when not needed.
  • Lower screen resolution or refresh rate.

Traps: turning off auto-lock or opening tens of tabs wastes power. Dark mode saves little on LCD, because the backlight is always on.

Exam wording: "On an OLED screen, black pixels do not emit light, so dark mode reduces power consumption."
cards.zh:
直觉：屏幕和无线功能（Wi-Fi、GPS）最耗电。

  • 开电池优化/省电模式。
  • 调低亮度；缩短自动锁屏时间。
  • OLED 深色模式：每个像素自己发光，黑色像素不发光、不耗电。
  • 关闭不用的 app 和分页；不用时关 Wi-Fi/蓝牙/GPS。
  • 降低解像度或刷新率。

陷阱：关掉自动锁屏或开几十个分页会浪费电。LCD 有常亮背光，深色模式省电不多。

ex.q: Why does dark mode save battery on an OLED phone?
ex.a:
1. OLED pixels emit their own light.
2. Black pixels are switched off → no power.
3. Dark mode has many black pixels → less power.
ex.az: OLED 黑色像素不发光→省电。

ex.q: Does dark mode save as much on an LCD laptop? Why?
ex.a:
1. No, not much.
2. LCD uses a backlight that is always on; dark colours only block the light.
ex.az: LCD 背光常亮，省电不多。

ex.q: List three settings to change before a long hike to save phone battery.
ex.a:
1. Power-saving mode on.
2. Lower brightness, short auto-lock.
3. Turn off Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; close background apps.
ex.az: 省电模式；低亮度短锁屏；关 Wi-Fi 蓝牙。

ex.q: "Turning off auto-lock saves power because the phone doesn't keep locking and unlocking." Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Without auto-lock the screen stays on, the biggest power user.
2. A shorter auto-lock time saves power.
ex.az: 关自动锁屏令屏幕常亮，更耗电；应缩短锁屏时间。

demo.title: Why OLED dark mode saves power

frames.en: All OLED pixels light up → high power.
Black pixels are off → no power for them.
LCD backlight is always on, so dark mode saves little.

mc.q: Which practice helps prevent repetitive strain injury in fingers and wrists caused by clicking the mouse?
o: Use a wrist rest to keep the wrist natural.
Maintain good lighting in the room.
mc.e: A wrist rest keeps the wrist straight; the others target leg, neck and eye problems.
mc.ez: 护腕令手腕平直，其余对应腿、颈、眼。

mc.q: Peter uses dual monitors. Which set-up is ergonomic? (1) swivel chair to avoid neck twisting (2) both monitors at arm's length (3) one monitor above the other
mc.e: Stacking monitors makes him tilt his head up.

mc.q: Susan installs a rest reminder app to prevent prolonged smart device use. Which feature should it include? (1) close the app she is using (2) turn off the device (3) push a rest notification
mc.e: A reminder should notify, not force-close apps or the device.

mc.q: Which interface features relate to user-friendly ergonomic design? (1) zoom for poor eyesight (2) consistent terms (3) stations grouped by rail line (4) sufficient colour contrast
mc.e: All reduce user effort or suit user abilities.

mc.q: Peter's feet do not reach the floor. Which ergonomic product prevents leg fatigue?
mc.e: A footrest keeps the feet flat.

mc.q: Without a footrest, what should Peter adjust to prevent leg fatigue? (1) chair height (2) monitor viewing angle (3) monitor height (4) table height
mc.e: Lower the chair so the feet rest flat (1). Then lower the table so the forearms stay horizontal (4), and lower the monitor so the top is at eye level (3). The viewing angle does not need to change.
mc.ez: 把椅子调低让双脚平放 (1)；再把桌子调低保持前臂水平 (4)；把显示器调低到视线水平 (3)。屏幕视角不必改。

mc.q: Which action can avoid neck pain from prolonged computer use?
o: Adjust the viewing angle of the monitor.
mc.e: Monitor angle slightly downward avoids bending the neck.
mc.ez: 调整显示器角度避免弯颈。
mc.src: Textbook E Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC1 (p.77)

mc.q: Why does Charles type documents on a desktop computer and keyboard instead of his tablet?
o: Mechanical keyboards allow better hand-eye coordination.
Desktop computers are easier to operate.
Desktop computers show texts more clearly on a larger screen.
mc.e: Adjustable monitor, keyboard and chair form an ergonomic workstation.
mc.ez: 桌面电脑配合人体工学设计。
mc.src: Textbook E Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC2 (p.77)

mc.q: The 20-20-20 rule says every 20 minutes you should look at something about how far away for 20 seconds?
According to the book, how often should you take a 5-minute break to stretch?
Deep vein thrombosis is dangerous mainly because
o: blood clots may travel to the lungs
mc.e: A clot reaching the lungs can be fatal.

mc.q: Which item reduces eyestrain caused by sunlight reflecting on the screen?
mc.e: Blinds block strong sunlight and reflections.

mc.q: Which of the following is NOT an ergonomic design?
o: Vertical mouse that avoids twisting the wrist
Adjustable font size in an app
mc.e: A password is a security feature.

mc.q: Splitting a long online registration into several short steps follows which interface guideline?
mc.e: Break complex tasks into simpler tasks (efficiency).

mc.q: Using universal icons such as a magnifying glass for 'search' mainly
mc.ez: 通用标志减少记忆负担。

mc.q: Using the same word 'Delete' (not 'Remove' in some screens and 'Erase' in others) throughout an app follows
'Tech neck' is mainly caused by
o: looking down at a phone for long periods

mc.q: Which is a sign of Internet addiction rather than a habit?
o: Being late for school because you could not stop gaming
Surfing for an hour after finishing homework
mc.e: Missing important tasks because you cannot stop.
mc.ez: 无法停止以致错过要事。

mc.q: George reads social media 6 hours daily. Which health issue will NOT arise from his Internet addiction?
mc.e: Diabetes is not a listed impact.

mc.q: Which are signs and symptoms of Internet addiction? (1) watching a movie on a streaming site every night (2) upset when cannot connect (3) thinking about the Internet during lessons (4) prioritising Internet over important tasks
mc.e: (1) alone is a normal leisure habit.
mc.src: Textbook E Ch2 Chapter Exercise MC7 (p.77)

mc.q: Which is a MENTAL health impact of Internet addiction listed in the book?
mc.e: Mental: poor memory, anxiety/depression, concentration difficulty.
mc.ez: 心理：记忆差、焦虑抑郁、难集中。

mc.q: 'Phubbing' means
o: ignoring the person you are with to look at your phone

mc.q: Which game feature best helps prevent teenagers' game addiction?
o: Automatic logout after a daily playtime limit

mc.q: Which is NOT a benefit (pro) of freedom of information in Table 2.2?
mc.e: Lack of quality control is a con.

mc.q: SOHO in the book refers to
mc.e: Small office/Home office: video conferencing, remote work, cloud collaboration.

mc.q: Ride-hailing and mobile payment are examples of which Internet change in Fig. 2.11?
Why can freedom of information lead to fines and imprisonment?
o: Abusing it to harm others (fake news, cyberbullying, scams) breaks laws
Using social media requires a licence
mc.e: Freedom does not justify harming others.
mc.ez: 滥用自由伤害他人会违法。

mc.q: Which con of freedom of information is shown when an old web page still lists last year's bus fares?
Which statement about cyberbullying is correct?
o: It is harassment over the Internet on any platform where people interact
Joking and bullying have the same effect
It is legal if the bully is anonymous
It only happens on social media
mc.e: Messaging apps, social media, games, forums, etc.

mc.q: Nearly what proportion of Hong Kong students have experienced cyberbullying according to the survey in the book?
A cyberbullying victim should FIRST avoid which of the following?
Which law can be used against posting someone's home address online to harass them?
Doxxing means
o: gathering and revealing others' private personal information online

mc.q: Which is a way for friends to support a cyberbullying victim?
o: Forward the bullying posts to more people to raise awareness
Tell the victim to reply to every comment
Ignore it because it is online only
Listen to and stay with the victim
mc.e: Support: listen and stay with the victim.

mc.q: Which emotional consequence of cyberbullying is mentioned in the book?
Patrick reposted fake news about an idol and left offensive comments. What should he have done?
o: Fact-check the information with other sources

mc.q: George claims a coupon bug and asks for DMs. Amy does not repost because: (1) it may be a scam as George's identity is unknown (2) it may cause a huge loss to the shop (3) it is illegal to steal coupons without authority
George posts Amy's phone number and photos and fake statements that she shoplifted. Which laws may he violate? (1) Copyright (2) Personal Data (Privacy) (3) Defamation

pr.task: A Grade 1 appliance saves a percentage of electricity compared with a Grade 5 one. Write savings(kwh5, pct, price) that returns the money saved per year, rounded to 2 decimal places: kwh5 = yearly kWh of the Grade 5 model, pct = percentage saved (e.g. 43), price = $ per kWh.
pr.taskz: 写 savings(kwh5, pct, price)，返回每年节省的金额（两位小数）。例如 1200 kWh、省 43%、$1.5/kWh → 774.0。
pr.solution:
def savings(kwh5, pct, price):
    return round(kwh5 * pct / 100 * price, 2)
